mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jobs (external_id, workspace_uuid, type, status, payload) SELECT 'job_session_title_' || s.uuid, s.workspace_uuid, 'session_title', CASE WHEN NULLIF(s.title, '') IS NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'completed' END, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('session_uuid', s.uuid, 'session_id', s.external_id, 'input', CASE WHEN NULLIF(s.title, '') IS NULL THEN CAST(#{input,sensitive=true} AS text) END)) FROM sessions s WHERE s.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND s.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND s.uuid = #{sessionUUID} AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status != 'terminated' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid AND j.external_id = 'job_session_title_' || s.uuid) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: WITH ready AS ( SELECT uuid FROM jobs WHERE type = 'session_title' AND run_after <= now() AND (status = 'pending' OR (status = 'running' AND locked_until < now())) ORDER BY run_after, created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE jobs j SET status = 'running', locked_by = #{workerID}, locked_until = now() + interval '1 minute', updated_at = now() FROM ready WHERE j.uuid = ready.uuid RETURNING j.uuid, j.workspace_uuid, j.payload->>'session_uuid' AS session_uuid, j.payload->>'session_id' AS session_id, j.payload->>'input' AS input

WITH completed AS ( UPDATE jobs SET status = 'completed', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, payload = payload - 'input', updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{params.JobUUID} AND type = 'session_title' AND status = 'running' AND locked_by = #{params.WorkerID} AND locked_until > now() RETURNING workspace_uuid, payload->>'session_uuid' AS session_uuid ) UPDATE sessions s SET title = #{params.Title,sensitive=true}, updated_at = now() FROM completed j WHERE s.workspace_uuid = j.workspace_uuid AND s.uuid = CAST(j.session_uuid AS uuid) AND NULLIF(s.title, '') IS NULL AND #{params.Title,sensitive=true} != '' AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status != 'terminated'
